def test_orders_create_and_get():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify user creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    address_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Verify address creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    card_data = {
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Verify card creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item['id']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_req = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")

    # Verify order creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("id") == order_id

    # Search orders
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_authorize():
    payment_req = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
            "street": "Downing Street"
        },
        "amount": 50.00,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Test",
            "lastName": "User"
        },
        "orderId": f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is True

    # Verify payment authorization
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{payment_req['orderId']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) > 0
    assert auths[0].get("orderId") == payment_req["orderId"]

def test_carts_add_item_cumulative():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item['id']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 2

    # Add item again
    cart_item_2 = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 3,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item_2, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cumulative state
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item['id']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 5

def test_carts_patch_item():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart item

    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify patched item

def test_carts_merge_success():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    item = items[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify session cart item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items/{item['id']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Merge session cart into customer cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer cart has the item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item['id']}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 2
